briefing.summary: Explore Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha’apai before the January 2022 eruption. Scan the volcanic rim slope and a nearby stretch of the flank; the shallow basin floor is an optional longer survey.
facts: Before the 15 January 2022 eruption, Hunga’s central basin was about 150–200 m deep and roughly 4.5 km across.
The 2014–2015 eruption built a cone that joined the two older islands, Hunga Tonga and Hunga Ha’apai.
The January 2022 eruption deepened the basin to about 850 m and separated the islands. This dive follows the earlier landscape.
With a surface start, head west-southwest and descend toward the volcanic rim slope.
hazards: Steep volcanic slopes: watch your altitude as you cross the rim.
Dim water along the deeper flank; use your lights to read the layered rock.
Pressure at the shallow basin floor is about 15–20 atmospheres.

objectives.title: Follow the volcanic rim slope
objectives.hint: Find the volcanic slope beyond the shallow basin, near 470 m.

objectives.title: Survey the nearby volcanic flank
objectives.hint: Follow the volcanic flank east-northeast from the rim-slope scan, near 293 m.

objectives.title: Survey the pre-2022 basin
objectives.hint: Optional longer survey: look east of the inner wall for the broad caldera basin, near 130 m.
